messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:

    earlier: Marcus carries the Team Boreal on-call phone from the 2025-02-27 rotation swap until the next rotation. [valid 2025-02-27 to 2025-04-16; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-27]
- As of 2026-03-12, Lena is the contact to page for anything related to Team Boreal. [valid 2026-03-12 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-12]

- Lena takes the first Boreal on-call shift of the year. [valid 2025-01-13 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-13]

    earlier: As of January 2025, the Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus. [valid 2025-01-07 to 2026-02-19; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-07]
- As of 2026-02-19, Lena has the Team Boreal pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus. [valid 2026-02-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-19-2]
    earlier: As of 2025-12-26, Marcus has the Team Boreal pager this cycle; pages for anything should go to Marcus, not Lena. [valid 2025-12-26 to 2026-02-19; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-26]

    earlier: As of 2026-04-13, Tomasz Nowak is the primary on-call for Team Dune. [valid 2026-04-13 to 2026-06-08; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-13]
- Oskar is on call for the Ember team to start the year. [valid 2025-01-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-14]

Question: Which team is Lena on?
